issue.title: Block chapter advancement while pericope takes cannot upload [Pericope view Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the pericope view audit (#534, epic #526).

**Severity:** High  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), `main` @ `4ebeae2`, local fluent-api @ `acc1404` (scenarios F.23b, G.25)

## Summary

In pericope mode the stage-advance CTA appears once every pericope has a take (#542). `confirmStageAdvancement` (`src/services/stageAdvance.ts`) then submits the chapter to the API without checking upload state. Because pericope takes never upload (see #584), a chapter drafted only with pericope takes reaches Peer Check with no audio on the server.

## Expected

A chapter does not advance while any of its selected takes cannot reach the server, or the translator is clearly warned and the advance is deferred.

## Actual

The chapter advances; the peer checker has no draft audio for it.

## Steps to reproduce

1. In pericope mode, record a pericope take for every pericope of a chapter.
2. Go to the last pericope and use the stage-advance CTA.
3. Check the chapter on web or the API: it is in Peer Check with no audio for those verses.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The advance CTA is disabled, or shows a blocking explanation, while the chapter has selected takes in the unuploadable bucket.
- [ ] Verse-mode advancement is unchanged.
- [ ] Unit tests cover `getStageAdvanceVisibility` / advance with unuploadable takes.
- [ ] Android device QA in pericope mode.
- [ ] Can be closed as superseded once pericope takes upload.

## Related

- Parent audit: #534 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #584 (pericope takes never upload)
- Feature: #542 (PR #550), #410
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/pericope-view/README.md` (PR #583)

comments.body: Cleanup: implementing PR already merged; board was stuck on In PR Review. Moved to **In QA** for post-merge nightly verification (Needs QA? Yes).

**### Test Results – Pericope Stage Advancement**

1. The stage-advance button is disabled when selected pericope takes cannot be uploaded to the server.
2. A clear warning message is displayed when the chapter cannot advance due to unuploadable pericope takes.
3. The chapter does not move to Peer Check while selected pericope takes are pending or unable to upload.
4. The translator can record takes for all pericopes without advancing the chapter prematurely.
5. Verse-mode stage advancement continues to work as expected.
6. No chapter reaches Peer Check without the required draft audio available on the server.

**Issue Identified:**

1\. The user cannot send the chapter to the next stage (Peer Check) because the recorded verse audio cannot sync to the server. Even after recording all pericope takes, the user cannot resolve the issue.
I was not able to test this, but it looks like it needs to be fixed.
